data.statement: A current enriched desk product supported a stronger functional narrative than a generic strange-object portrait: the architecture execution explains the improbable tape roll, cutter, paperclip bowl, and pen block in one frame, while the equally faithful gallery execution lost because its display mechanism was replaceable.
data.decision: Keep attempt-v7-butt-tape-architecture-1 as the run's only survivor and do not spend the one allowed revision on a non-gating cosmetic preference.
